items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 04 May 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

North or Northeast 2 to 4, backing North or Northwest this afternoon, but remaining Variable 3 or less in places throughout the period.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, veering Northerly 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then North or Northeast in the afternoon. Further veering East or Southeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional light/patchy rain tomorrow evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
